en.headline: 12 commits across two repos, 2 issues opened, 1 discussion started
en.summary: On 2026-10-16 the user logged **12 own commits** across two repositories, plus 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (7 commits) the work was documentation-heavy: adding an `AGENTS.md`, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, archiving OpenCode V2 distribution/architecture/auth and Windows path notes, archiving oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode findings, generalizing the knowledge scope beyond Git/GitHub, making knowledge supplements a default action, and noting the origin remote. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (5 commits) the daily CLI gained a `--force` flag to skip the comment-count snapshot freeze and to re-fetch snapshots for finalized dates, candidate entries stopped being filtered by whether `updated_at` fell inside the window, comment-count semantics and target search were tightened per review feedback, and a +08 early-morning reply-collection gap was fixed while Issue/PR rows now display comment counts. The user opened 2 issues in `anomalyco/opencode`: #55785 on `go: mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image (400)` and #55772 on `[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it`; both remain open, with 3 and 1 comments respectively.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共 12 次提交，新开 2 个 issue，发起 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-16 当天，用户在两个仓库共完成 **12 次本人提交**，另有 15 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`（7 次）以文档工作为主：新增 `AGENTS.md`，建立 `knowledge/` 目录用于归档 Git & GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图，归档 OpenCode V2 分发/架构/认证与 Windows 路径坑，归档 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 实测知识，将 knowledge 范围泛化为「各种知识」不再限定 Git/GitHub，把 knowledge 补充改为默认动作并允许架构随内容调整，以及在 AGENTS.md 中注明 origin remote。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`（5 次）为 daily CLI 增加 `--force` 参数以跳过评论数快照冻结并对已定稿日期重取快照，候选条目不再按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤，按复审意见收紧评论数口径与 target 检索，修复 +08 凌晨漏采回复的问题，并让 Issue/PR 行显示评论数。用户在 `anomalyco/opencode` 新开 2 个 issue：#55785 `go: mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image (400)` 与 #55772 `[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it`，两者均处于 open 状态，评论数分别为 3 和 1。两条 issue 均收到回复：#55785 上有 `opencode-agent[bot]` 与 `micahgerges` 的评论，#55772 上有 `opencode-agent[bot]` 的评论。此外 `Tarquinen` 关闭了 #51263（`websearch: tinyfish provider returns HTTP 400 (missing Mcp-Session-Id) on every search`）。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起讨论 #4982，标题为 `Share session archive state with OpenCode's own clients`，归类于 Ideas。当日无 PR、无 review、无 release，且各采集分区均未触及上限。
